'''Oak Dancer''' was a she-[[wolf]]. She was named for the way she scampered between saplings as a whelp.

== Appearance ==
She was youthful with a very light pelt and a streak of black along the right side.

== Activities ==
Oak Dancer was one of the wolves [[Perrin Aybara]] met in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]''. She joined him on his hunt of the white stag.
She was present when [[Hopper]] continued to teach Perrin how to hunt in the wolf dream.
Oak Dancer is one of the wolves Hopper used to ''shift'' to other places and then get Perrin to track through scent. She was trapped behind the [[dreamspike]] when [[Slayer]] set it up and started hunting the wolves. 
Perrin returned to the wolf dream and attacked Slayer with the aid of the wolf pack. Oak Dancer was stabbed and killed during the encounter.
